    185                                                                  end

    187                                                                  // NAK triggers retransmission
    188                                                                  else if (nak) begin

    236             1                    ***0***                         state         <= IDLE;
    237             1                    ***0***                         timeout_count <= '0;
    238                                              
    239                                                              end
    240                                              
    241                                                          endcase
    242                                              
    243                                                      end
